# VirusTotal

VirusTotal is a free online service that analyzes files and URLs for viruses, worms, trojans, and other kinds of malicious content using multiple antivirus engines and website scanners.

Category: Security & Ops. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/virustotal/.

## Actions

- **Get Analysis Report** (read-only): Retrieve the analysis report of a file or url submission.
- **Get Domain Report** (read-only): Retrieve the analysis report of a domain.
- **Get File Report** (read-only): Retrieve the analysis report of a file.
- **Get IP Address Report** (read-only): Retrieve the analysis report of an ip address.
- **Get URL Report** (read-only): Retrieve the analysis report of a url.
- **Get VirusTotal Metadata** (read-only): Retrieve virustotal metadata.
- **Rescan File**: Re-analyze a previously submitted file.
- **Scan URL**: Submit a url for scanning.
- **Search VirusTotal** (read-only): Search for objects in the virustotal database.
- **Upload File**: Upload a file for scanning.
- **Add VirusTotal Comment**: Add a comment to a virustotal resource (file, url, domain, or ip address).
- **Add Vote**: Add a vote (harmless/malicious) to a virustotal resource.
- **Get comments** (read-only): Retrieve the latest comments on a virustotal resource.
- **Get Domain Relationships** (read-only): Retrieve relationship objects for a given domain.
- **Get IP Address Relationships** (read-only): Retrieve objects related to a specific ip address by relationship type.
- **Get Votes** (read-only): Retrieve votes on files, urls, domains, or ip addresses.
